isd.text: Avacyn was created by Sorin Markov to protect humanity, and when she and her angels came to Innistrad a new equilibrium was reached as they slew vampires, werewolves, geists and ghouls, prompting Sorin's kin to brand him a traitor.
As demons kept returning in new forms she decreed that what cannot be destroyed will be bound, forged a collar of silver, and imprisoned the captured demons in the Helvault.

Then the demon Griselbrand landed on the Helvault under a full moon and challenged her; after days of battle she drove him in, but he impaled her heart with his spear and the backlashing spell drew her into the Helvault too.
With Avacyn missing, prayers and holy symbols fail to protect villages and the dead, and the Church's power wanes.

dka.text: Avacyn is gone from Innistrad in Dark Ascension, and her absence upsets the balance between humans and monsters, because the demon Griselbrand turned the Helvault against her and trapped her inside.
Her flights of angels cannot protect Innistrad as before, suffering wounds and retreating, and humans lose hope, topple her statues and turn to demonic cults.
Then Liliana forces Thalia to destroy the Helvault by threatening her soldiers, releasing Avacyn and the demons, and Avacyn casts the Cursemute and creates the Wolfir.

avr.text: In Avacyn Restored, a golden helix streaks from the Helvault, which explodes, and Avacyn emerges free from her prison.
She rallies her troops to contain the demonic threat and cleanse Innistrad, and in a wave of spells called the Cursemute she cleanses the world with divine fire.
She offers repentant werewolves a place at her side and decrees they become the wolfir, allies against darkness.
Yet her freedom came at a price, and her madness comes to be traced to Nahiri's cryptoliths, which summon Emrakul and drive many angels, including Avacyn, mad.

m15.text: In Magic 2015, Avacyn is seen through the eyes of her faithful: Vronos returns as a penitent and she forgives him, then tasks him with finding the cursed planeswalker Garruk and bringing him to her cathedral.
Dovid, wounded at Child's Wall, is summoned by Avacyn and her angel Gryta, and she touches the point of Eost, the sword forged from the Helvault that is presented to him.

Dovid later learns that Avacyn had been sealed in the Helvault with Griselbrand while the church's power diminished, and that Sorin created her to hold the vampires in check, so he concludes his faith is a lie.

soi.text: Avacyn has finally returned to Innistrad in Shadows over Innistrad, but new evils have come with her and madness plagues the inhabitants, as the howling of werewolves marks the end of the Cursemute and the start of her madness.
A violent shimmer racks her and she begins to see mortals as rotten, mocking Lunarch Macher, who is left certain of the true nature of his god, while a winged figure kills the werewolf Liont.

She argues that humans are as guilty as the monsters and must be punished, and when Kelse prays to her for help she finds Avacyn herself, dressed in black with blood-red wings, leading the destruction, and Avacyn kills her with her spear.
At the cathedral she overcomes Tamiyo's story magic and Jace's mental assault and tortures Jace, until Sorin crashes through the skylight and reveals that he is her creator.

emn.text: Avacyn is destroyed in Eldritch Moon: at Thraben Cathedral she overpowers Jace and Tamiyo until Sorin arrives and tells her he is her creator.
Sorin plummets her into the Vault of the Archangel, and when she refuses healing he unravels the spell that formed her, ending her existence.
With Avacyn dead, Innistrad's last protections fade, and Maeli prays to her for help in vain.

Thalia's party meets Rem Karolus, who carries Avacyn's broken spear, and Thalia shows it to her army and urges them to fight for the memory of the light and goodness that have fled, while her faithful build a memorial to her from wood, straw, twine and clay.

mh1.text: On the cards of Modern Horizons, Avacyn is remembered as an angel before whose divine might craven beasts once cowered.
